Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-TEST-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-TEST-D-INTERP — who pays a foreign-language interpreter for the knowledge test (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NJ-TEST-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-TEST-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the language list, interpreter registries, the voter registration deadline, websites and phone numbers (for example sec03-F05, sec03-F23) can change and must be refreshed from the MVC and Division of Elections websites.
